title: Run consumer tests of changed files in krn verify
body: Outcome: krn verify targeted tests include every test that exercises a changed script or module, not only the observer. Evidence: PR #176 changed scripts/pr-preflight.mjs; krn verify passed, but test/flow/review-budget.test.ts (in-process review then preflight) failed in CI. Acceptance: krn verify selects test files that import or spawn a changed file (static scan of import specifiers and script paths), runs them through scripts/test-suite.mjs, with an observer red at base by assertion.
